text: Bumblebees can learn to open flowers by watching another bee, then remember the technique—useful evidence that some insects pick up skills socially.
In South Korea, restaurants and households separate food scraps for composting and animal feed; turning leftovers into useful resources is an established part of waste reduction.
Send a neighbour a quick message asking what local bird they’ve spotted lately, then share your own sighting; it’s an easy way to start a friendly exchange.
